title: Finitely many points with one-dimensional Noetherian local rings on an integral separated scheme lie in an affine open
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces an affine open subscheme of an integral separated scheme X containing a prescribed finite set of points whose local rings are Noetherian of dimension at most one. The proof is a genuine construction: it shows that no valuation ring of the function field can dominate two of the local rings A_i and A_j, by the valuative criterion of separatedness applied to a square, and consequently each A_i tensor A_j -> K is surjective; it then takes A = intersection of the A_i, uses a glueing lemma to see that A is Noetherian semi-local with the A_i as its localizations at maximal ideals, verifies that the Spec(A_i) form an open covering of Spec(A) with pairwise intersections Spec(K), and glues the given morphisms Spec(A_i) -> X into a morphism Spec(A) -> X mapping the maximal ideals to the prescribed points with isomorphisms on local rings (proof lines 9025-9057). H3: the valuation-theoretic separation step and the glueing of the local models into one affine piece are independent research-level arguments.
